original: sādhu bhagavann ity āyuṣmān ānando bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavantaṃ triḥpradakṣiṇīkṛtya yena svātir bhikṣus tenopasaṃkramya svāter bhikṣor anayā mahāmāyūryā vidyārājñyā rakṣām akārṣīt.
analyzed: sādhu bhagavan iti āyuṣmān ānandaḥ bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā bhagavantam tris pradakṣiṇīkṛtya yena svātiḥ bhikṣuḥ tena upasaṃkramya svāteḥ bhikṣoḥ anayā mahāmāyūryā vidyā rājñyā rakṣām akārṣīt

original: guptiṃ paritrāṇaṃ parigrahaṃ paripālanaṃ śāntiṃ svastyayanaṃ daṇḍaparihāraṃ śastraparihāraṃ viṣadūṣaṇaṃ viṣanāśanaṃ sīmābandhaṃ dharaṇībandhaṃ cākārṣīt, vyutthitaś cāyuṣmān svātir bhikṣus tasmād ābādhād āyuṣmatā ānandena rakṣāsvastyayane kṛte.
analyzed: guptim paritrāṇam parigraham paripālanam śāntim svastyayanam daṇḍa parihāram śastra parihāram viṣa dūṣaṇam viṣa nāśanam sīmābandham dharaṇībandham ca akārṣīt vyutthitaḥ ca āyuṣmān svātiḥ bhikṣuḥ tasmāt ābādhāt āyuṣmatā ānandena rakṣā svastyayane kṛte

original: athāyuṣmān ānanda āyuṣmāṃś ca svātir bhikṣur yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkrāntau, upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasābhivandya bhagavataḥ sarvaṃ yathā vṛttāntaṃ nivedya bhagavatānujñatau caikānte niṣaṇṇau.
analyzed: atha āyuṣmān ānandaḥ āyuṣmān ca svātiḥ bhikṣuḥ yena bhagavān tena upasaṃkrāntau upasaṃkramya bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā abhivandya bhagavataḥ sarvam yathā vṛttāntam nivedya bhagavatā anujñatau ca ekānte niṣaṇṇau

original: atha bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam uvāca. dṛṣṭas te mahāmāyūryā vidyārājñāḥ prabhāva iti. tathā vāditaṃ bhagavantam ānandaḥ praṇamyovāca. kim idaṃ bhagavan na viditaṃ bhaviṣyati. bhagavān punar uvāca.
analyzed: atha bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam uvāca dṛṣṭaḥ te mahāmāyūryāḥ vidyā rājñāḥ prabhāvaḥ iti tathā vāditam bhagavantam ānandaḥ praṇamya uvāca kim idam bhagavat na viditam bhaviṣyati bhagavān punar uvāca

original: apy evānanda catvāro mahāsamudrāḥ śoṣaṃ gaccheyuḥ, pṛthivī vā ākāśam utpadyet, candrādityau vā pṛthivyāṃ nipatetāṃ, nadyo vā pratiśroto gaccheyuḥ, na ca tathāgatasya vacanam anyathā bhaved iti. atha bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam āmantrayate sma.
analyzed: api eva ānanda catvāraḥ mahā samudrāḥ śoṣam gaccheyuḥ pṛthivī vā ākāśam utpadyet candra ādityau vā pṛthivyām nipatetām nadyaḥ vā pratiśrotas gaccheyuḥ na ca tathāgatasya vacanam anyathā bhavet iti atha bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam āmantrayate sma

original: tasmāt tarhi tvam ānanda imāṃ mahāmāyūrīṃ vidyārājñīṃ catasṛṇāṃ parṣadāṃ rakṣāvaraṇaguptaye bhikṣūṇāṃ bhikṣuṇīṇām upāsakānām upāsikānāṃ cārocaya. sādhu bhagavann ity āyuṣmān ānando bhagavataḥ pratiśrutya imāṃ mahāmāyūrīṃ vidyārājñīṃ catasṛṇāṃ parṣadām ārocayati bhikṣūṇāṃ bhikṣuṇīṇām upāsakānām upāsikānāṃ ceti.
analyzed: tasmāt tarhi tvam ānanda imām mahāmāyūrīm vidyā rājñīm catasṛṇām parṣadām rakṣā āvaraṇa guptaye bhikṣūṇām bhikṣuṇīṇām upāsakānām upāsikānām ca ārocaya sādhu bhagavan iti āyuṣmān ānandaḥ bhagavataḥ pratiśrutya imām mahāmāyūrīm vidyā rājñīm catasṛṇām parṣadām ārocayati bhikṣūṇām bhikṣuṇīṇām upāsakānām upāsikānām ca iti

original: (Mmvr Taku 61)

idam avocad bhagavān, āttamanā āyuṣmān ānanda āyuṣmāṃś ca svātir bhikṣur, ye ca tasyāṃ parṣadi sannipatitāḥ sanniṣaṇṇāḥ devanāgayakṣagandharvāsuragaruḍakinnaramahoragayakṣārākṣasamanuṣyāmanuṣyās te ca sarve bhagavato bhāṣitam abhyanandann iti.
analyzed: idam avocat bhagavān ātta manāḥ āyuṣmān ānandaḥ āyuṣmān ca svātiḥ bhikṣuḥ ye ca tasyām parṣadi sannipatitāḥ sanniṣaṇṇāḥ deva nāga yakṣa gandharva asura garuḍa kinnara mahoraga yakṣa arākṣasa manuṣya amanuṣyāḥ te ca sarve bhagavataḥ bhāṣitam abhyanandan iti

original: samāptā ceyaṃ bhagavaty āryamahāmāyūrī vidyārājñī.
analyzed: samāptā ca iyam bhagavatī ārya mahāmāyūrī vidyā rājñī

original: avinaṣṭā yakṣamukhāt pratilabdhā navaśatikā buddhabhāṣitā.
analyzed: a vinaṣṭā yakṣa mukhāt pratilabdhā nava śatikā buddha bhāṣitā

original: rakṣa māṃ sarvasatvāṃś ca svastiśreyo bhavatv iti.
analyzed: rakṣa mām sarva satvān ca svasti śreyaḥ bhavatu iti

original: asyā mahāmāyūryā vidyārājñyā ayam upacāraḥ. apatitakapilagomayena śucau bhūmipradeśe gocarmamātraṃ sthaṇḍilam upalipya samutpannena kāryeṇa yena kenacid gomayena caturaśraṃ maṇḍalakaṃ kartavyaṃ.
analyzed: asyāḥ mahāmāyūryāḥ vidyā rājñyāḥ ayam upacāraḥ a patita kapila gomayena śucau bhūmi pradeśe gocarma mātram sthaṇḍilam upalipya samutpannena kāryeṇa yena kenacid gomayena caturaśram maṇḍalakam kartavyam

original: tatra ca madhye buddhapratimā paścimābhimukhā sthāpayitavyā, tasyā vāmapārśve mahāmāyūrīpustakalikhitā citrakarmakṛtā vā sthāpayitavyā, atha vā trayo mayūracandrikāḥ kapilagomaye niṣadya sthāpayitavyāḥ, tataḥ śvetārkapuṣpāṇi śvetakaravīrabilbapatrāṇi śirīṣapatrāṇi ca datvā baliṃ tilakṛsaratilodakaṃ caiva pāyasaṃ
analyzed: tatra ca madhye buddha pratimā paścima abhimukhā sthāpayitavyā tasyāḥ vāma pārśve mahā māyūrī pustaka likhitā citra karma kṛtā vā sthāpayitavyā atha vā trayaḥ mayūracandrikāḥ kapila gomaye niṣadya sthāpayitavyāḥ tatas śveta arka puṣpāṇi śveta karavīra bilba patrāṇi śirīṣa patrāṇi ca da tvā balim tila kṛsara tila udakam ca eva pāyasam

original: guḍapūrṇakayāvakamadhupūrṇakabhaktāṃ yathā lābhena datvā prāṅmukhena gugguludhūpaṃ ca datvā tato dakṣiṇapaścimottaramukhena caturdiśaṃ pūrvoktānāṃ caturdiśānāṃ yakṣāṇām agrahāṃ kurvatā vaktavyaṃ, āgacchadhvaṃ, puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ gandhaṃ baliṃ dīpaṃ ca pratīcchadhvaṃ, rakṣa māṃ sarvasatvānāṃś ca. Oṃ varade hūṃ (Mmvr Taku 62) hariṇi sphuṭ kāriṇi svāhā.
analyzed: guḍa pūrṇaka yāvaka madhu pūrṇaka bhaktām yathā lābhena da tvā prāc mukhena guggulu dhūpam ca da tvā tatas dakṣiṇa paścima uttara mukhena caturdiśam pūrva uktānām caturdiśānām yakṣāṇām agrahām kurvatā vaktavyam āgacchadhvam puṣpam dhūpam gandham balim dīpam ca pratīcchadhvam rakṣa mām sarva sattvānām ca Om  vara de SVF hūm  hariṇi sphuṭ kāriṇi svāhā

original: tatra guḍapūrṇapāyasaṃ ca pūrvāyāṃ diśi sthāpayitavyaṃ, gandharvāṇāṃ sa baliḥ, tilakṛsarasurāpūrṇakaṃ ca dakṣiṇāyāṃ diśi sthāpayitavyaṃ, kumbhāṇḍānāṃ sa baliḥ. kṣīrapūrṇakaṃ pāyasaṃ ca paścimāyāṃ diśi sthāpayitavyaṃ, nāgasuparṇīnāṃ sa baliḥ. siṃdhupūrṇakaṃ dadhibhaktam uttarasyāṃ diśi sthāpayitavyaṃ, yakṣāṇāṃ sa baliḥ.
analyzed: tatra guḍa pūrṇa pāyasam ca pūrvāyām diśi sthāpayitavyam gandharvāṇām sa baliḥ tila kṛsara surā pūrṇakam ca dakṣiṇāyām diśi sthāpayitavyam kumbhāṇḍānām sa baliḥ kṣīra pūrṇakam pāyasam ca paścimāyām diśi sthāpayitavyam nāga suparṇīnām sa baliḥ siṃdhu pūrṇakam dadhi bhaktam uttarasyām diśi sthāpayitavyam yakṣāṇām sa baliḥ

original: āryamahāmāyūrī nāma mahāvidyārājñī samāptā iti.
analyzed: ārya mahāmāyūrī nāma mahāvidyā rājñī samāptā iti

original: ye dharmā hetuprabhavā hetuṃ teṣāṃ tathāgato hy avadat,
analyzed: ye dharmāḥ hetu prabhavāḥ hetum teṣām tathāgataḥ hi avadat

original: teṣāṃ ca yo nirodha evaṃvādī mahāśramaṇaḥ.
analyzed: teṣām ca yaḥ nirodhaḥ evaṃvādī mahāśramaṇaḥ
